title: Oxford 3000 Core Fundamentals
description: Từ vựng cốt lõi thiết yếu định hình nền tảng tiếng Anh giao tiếp và học thuật.

meanings: used before countable or singular nouns referring to people or things that have not already been mentioned.
examples: a man/horse/unit

meanings: to leave somebody, especially somebody you are responsible for, with no intention of returning.
examples: abandon somebody, The baby had been abandoned by its mother.

meanings: the fact that somebody/something is able to do something.
examples: People with the disease may lose their ability to communicate.

meanings: to have the skill, intelligence, opportunity, etc. needed to do something.
examples: You must be able to speak French for this job.

words.general_translation_vi: Xung quanh, quanh quẩn, đây đó, rải rác
meanings: a little more or less than; a little before or after.
examples: It costs about $10.

meanings: at or to a higher place.
examples: Put it on the shelf above.

words.general_translation_vi: Ở nước ngoài, ra nước ngoài
meanings: in or to a foreign country.
examples: to go/travel/live/study abroad

meanings: total and complete.
examples: I've joined a class for absolute beginners.

meanings: used to emphasize that something is completely true.
examples: You're absolutely right.

meanings: connected with education, especially studying in schools and universities.
examples: high/low academic standards

meanings: to take willingly something that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc.
examples: He asked me to marry him and I accepted.

words.general_translation_vi: Có thể nhận, có thể chấp nhận
meanings: agreed or approved of by most people in a society.
examples: Children must learn socially acceptable behaviour.

words.general_translation_vi: Lối vào, cửa vào, đường vào
meanings: the opportunity or right to use something or to see somebody/something.
examples: High-speed internet access has become a necessity.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự rủi ro, tai nạn, tai biến
meanings: an unpleasant event, especially in a vehicle, that happens unexpectedly and causes injury or damage.
examples: a car/road/traffic accident

words.general_translation_vi: Sự điều tiết, sự thích nghi, sự làm cho phù hợp
meanings: a place to live, work or stay in.
examples: rented/temporary accommodation

words.general_translation_vi: Đi theo, đi cùng, đi kèm, đồng hành
meanings: to travel or go somewhere with somebody/something.
examples: accompany somebody/something + adv./prep., His wife accompanied him on the trip.

meanings: as stated or reported by somebody/something.
examples: According to Mick, it's a great movie.

meanings: an arrangement that somebody has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc.
examples: I don't have a bank account.

words.general_translation_vi: Đúng đắn, chính xác, xác đáng
meanings: correct and true in every detail.
examples: an accurate description/picture of something

words.general_translation_vi: Cáo buộc, buộc tội, kết tội
meanings: to say that somebody has done something wrong or is guilty of something.
examples: accuse somebody of something, to accuse somebody of murder/a crime

meanings: to succeed in reaching a particular goal, status or standard, especially by making an effort for a long time.
examples: He had finally achieved success.

meanings: a thing that somebody has done successfully, especially using their own effort and skill.
examples: the greatest scientific achievement of the decade

meanings: to accept that something is true.
examples: acknowledge something, She refuses to acknowledge the need for reform.

meanings: to gain something by your own efforts, ability or behaviour.
examples: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.

meanings: from one side to the other side.
examples: It's too wide. We can't swim across.

words.general_translation_vi: Hành động, việc làm, cử chỉ, hành vi
meanings: a particular thing that somebody does.
examples: You have committed a serious criminal act.

meanings: the process of doing something in order to make something happen or to deal with a situation.
examples: The time has come for action if these beautiful animals are to survive.

meanings: always busy doing things, especially physical activities.
examples: Staying physically active in later years can also keep you feeling younger.

meanings: a thing that you do for interest or pleasure.
examples: leisure/outdoor/recreational activities

words.general_translation_vi: Diễn viên (kịch, tuồng, chèo, điện ảnh...)
meanings: a person who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession.
examples: Both lead actors (= the ones who play the main parts) are outstanding.

meanings: a woman who performs on the stage, on television or in films, especially as a profession.
examples: The Oscar-winning actress has taken a break from acting.

words.general_translation_vi: Thật sự, thật, thực tế, có thật
meanings: used to emphasize something that is real or exists in fact.
examples: James looks younger than his wife but in actual fact (= really) he is five years older.

meanings: used in speaking to emphasize a fact or a comment, or that something is really true.
examples: What did she actually say?

meanings: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service.
examples: The TV ads were first run last year.

meanings: to change your behaviour in order to deal more successfully with a new situation.
examples: It's amazing how soon you adapt.

meanings: to put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, amount, etc.
examples: add something, Next add the flour.

meanings: a thing that is added to something else.
examples: All of these technologies are fairly recent additions.

words.general_translation_vi: Thêm vào, phụ vào, tăng thêm
meanings: more than was first mentioned or is usual.
examples: additional resources/funds/security/funding/costs

meanings: details of where somebody lives or works and where letters, etc. can be sent.
examples: What's your name and address?

words.general_translation_vi: Sự trông nom, sự quản lý
meanings: the activities that are done in order to plan, organize and run a business, school or other institution.
examples: Administration costs are passed on to the customer.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngắm nhìn một cách vui thích
meanings: to respect somebody for what they have done or to respect their qualities.
examples: admire somebody/something, I really admire your enthusiasm.

meanings: to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true.
examples: It was a stupid thing to do, I admit.

meanings: to take somebody else’s child into your family and become its legal parent(s).
examples: a campaign to encourage childless couples to adopt

words.general_translation_vi: Người lớn, người đã trưởng thành
meanings: fully grown or developed.
examples: preparing young people for adult life

words.general_translation_vi: Sự tiến lên, sự tiến tới, sự tiến bộ
meanings: done or given before something is going to happen.
examples: Please give us advance warning of any changes.

words.general_translation_vi: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của advance
meanings: having the most modern and recently developed ideas, methods, etc.
examples: Scientists are working on highly advanced technology to replace fossil fuels.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự thuận lợi, hoàn cảnh thuận lợi
meanings: a thing that helps you to be better or more successful than other people.
examples: a distinct/significant/huge advantage

meanings: an unusual, exciting or dangerous experience, journey or series of events.
examples: her adventures travelling in Africa

words.general_translation_vi: Báo cho biết, báo cho ai biết trước
meanings: to tell the public about a product or a service in order to encourage people to buy or to use it.
examples: If you want to attract customers you need to advertise.

meanings: a notice, picture or film telling people about a product, job or service.
examples: a newspaper/television advertisement

words.general_translation_vi: Sự quảng cáo, nghề quảng cáo
meanings: the activity and industry of advertising things to people on television, in newspapers, on the internet, etc.
examples: Cigarette advertising has been banned.

meanings: an opinion or a suggestion about what somebody should do in a particular situation.
examples: expert/practical/professional/medical advice

meanings: to tell somebody what you think they should do in a particular situation.
examples: advise against doing something, I would strongly advise against going out on your own.

meanings: events that are of public interest or political importance.
examples: world/international affairs

words.general_translation_vi: Làm ảnh hưởng đến, làm tác động đến
meanings: to produce a change in somebody/something.
examples: How will these changes affect us?

words.general_translation_vi: Có thể, có đủ sức, có đủ khả năng, có đủ điều kiện (để làm gì)
meanings: to have enough money to be able to buy or do something.
examples: afford something, Can we afford a new car?

meanings: feeling fear; frightened because you think that you might be hurt or suffer.
examples: Don't be afraid.

meanings: later in time; afterwards.
examples: That was in 1996. Soon after, I heard that he'd died.

meanings: the period of time from 12 o'clock in the middle of the day until about 6 o’clock in the evening.
examples: this/yesterday/tomorrow afternoon

words.general_translation_vi: Sau này, về sau, sau đấy, rồi thì
meanings: at a later time; after an event that has already been mentioned.
examples: Afterwards she was sorry for what she'd said.

meanings: one more time; on another occasion.
examples: This must never happen again.

words.general_translation_vi: Chống lại, ngược lại, phản đối
meanings: opposing or disagreeing with somebody/something.
examples: the fight against terrorism

meanings: the number of years that a person has lived or a thing has existed.
examples: You're the same age as my brother.

meanings: of the age of.
examples: They have two children aged six and nine.

meanings: a business or an organization that provides a particular service especially when representing other businesses or organizations.
examples: She works for an advertising agency.

meanings: a list of items to be discussed at a meeting.
examples: We have a very full agenda of issues to discuss.

meanings: a person whose job is to act for, or manage the affairs of, other people in business, politics, etc.
examples: Our agent in New York deals with all US sales.

meanings: angry, and behaving in a threatening way; ready to attack.
examples: Seals have been known to exhibit aggressive behaviour towards swimmers.

meanings: used in expressions of time with the simple past tense to show how far in the past something happened.
examples: two weeks/months/years ago

words.general_translation_vi: Đồng ý, tán thành, bằng lòng, thoả thuận
meanings: to have the same opinion as somebody; to say that you have the same opinion.
examples: When he said that, I had to agree.

meanings: an arrangement, a promise or a contract made with somebody.
examples: an international peace agreement

meanings: used to express surprise, pleasure or sympathy, or when you disagree with somebody.
examples: Ah, there you are!

words.general_translation_vi: Trước, về phía trước, ở thẳng phía trước
meanings: further forward in space or time; in front.
examples: I'll run ahead and warn them.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự giúp đỡ, sự cứu giúp, sự viện trợ
meanings: money, food, etc. that is sent to help countries in difficult situations.
examples: humanitarian/food/medical aid

meanings: the purpose of doing something; what somebody is trying to achieve.
examples: the stated aims of the study

meanings: the mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that we breathe.
examples: Let's go out for some fresh air.

meanings: any vehicle that can fly and carry goods or passengers.
examples: fighter/transport/military aircraft

meanings: a company that provides regular flights to take passengers and goods to different places.
examples: an airline pilot/passenger

meanings: a place where planes land and take off and that has buildings for passengers to wait in.
examples: Gatwick Airport

words.general_translation_vi: Sự báo động, sự báo nguy
meanings: a loud noise or a signal that warns people of danger or of a problem.
examples: She decided to sound the alarm (= warn people that the situation was dangerous).

meanings: a book in which you keep photographs, stamps, etc.
examples: a photo album

meanings: drinks such as beer, wine, etc. that can make people drunk.
examples: He never drinks alcohol.

meanings: connected with or containing alcohol.
examples: alcoholic drinks/beverages

meanings: living; not dead.
examples: Is your mother still alive?

words.general_translation_vi: Tất cả, hết thảy, toàn bộ, suốt trọn, mọi
meanings: completely.
examples: She was dressed all in white.

meanings: acceptable; in an acceptable manner.
examples: Is the coffee all right?

meanings: to let somebody/something do something; to let something happen or be done.
examples: allow somebody/something to do something, His parents won't allow him to stay out late.

words.general_translation_vi: Hầu (như), gần (như), suýt nữa, tí nữa
meanings: not quite.
examples: I like almost all of them.

words.general_translation_vi: Một mình, trơ trọi, cô độc, đơn độc
meanings: without any other people.
examples: not alone in, Tom is not alone in finding Rick hard to work with.

meanings: forward.
examples: I was just walking along singing to myself.

meanings: before now or before a particular time in the past.
examples: ‘Lunch?’ ‘No thanks, I've already eaten.’

meanings: in addition; too.
examples: She's fluent in French and German. She also speaks a little Italian.

meanings: to become different; to make somebody/something different.
examples: Prices did not alter significantly during 2019.

meanings: that can be used instead of something else.
examples: The road was closed so we had to find an alternative route.

meanings: used for introducing a statement that makes the main statement in a sentence seem surprising.
examples: Although the sun was shining, it wasn't very warm.

words.general_translation_vi: Luôn luôn, lúc nào cũng, bao giờ cũng, mãi mãi, hoài
meanings: at all times; on every occasion.
examples: There's almost always somebody at home in the evenings.

words.general_translation_vi: Quá khứ và phân từ quá khứ của amaze
meanings: very surprised.
examples: an amazed look

words.general_translation_vi: Dạng phân từ hiện tại và danh động từ (gerund) của amaze
meanings: very surprising, especially in a way that you like or admire.
examples: an amazing feat/story/experience

meanings: something that you want to do or achieve very much.
examples: She had fulfilled her lifelong ambition.

words.general_translation_vi: Có nhiều hoài bão, có nhiều khát vọng
meanings: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
examples: a fiercely ambitious young manager

meanings: surrounded by somebody/something; in the middle of somebody/something.
examples: a house among the trees

meanings: a quantity of something.
examples: I was amazed at the amount he could eat.

meanings: to examine the nature or structure of something, especially by separating it into its parts, in order to understand or explain it.
examples: analyse something, The job involves collecting and analysing data.

meanings: the detailed study or examination of something in order to understand more about it; the result of the study.
examples: statistical/data analysis

meanings: belonging to a period of history that is thousands of years in the past.
examples: Archaeologists are excavating the ruined temples of this ancient civilization.

meanings: also; in addition to.
examples: bread and butter

words.general_translation_vi: Sự tức giận, sự giận dữ
meanings: the strong feeling that you have when something has happened that you think is bad and unfair.
examples: She had to find a way to express her pent-up anger.

meanings: the space between two lines or surfaces that join, measured in degrees.
examples: a 45° angle

meanings: having strong feelings about something that you dislike very much or about an unfair situation.
examples: Her behaviour really made me angry.

meanings: a creature that is not a bird, a fish, a reptile, an insect or a human.
examples: the animals and birds of South America

meanings: the joint connecting the foot to the leg; the narrow part of the leg just above the ankle joint.
examples: to sprain/break/twist your ankle

meanings: a date that is an exact number of years after the date of an important or special event.
examples: on the anniversary of his wife’s death

meanings: to tell people something officially, especially about a decision, plans, etc.
examples: announce something, He officially announced his intention to resign at today's press conference.

meanings: a spoken or written statement that informs people about something.
examples: to make an announcement

words.general_translation_vi: Làm trái ý, làm khó chịu, làm bực mình
meanings: to make somebody slightly angry.
examples: annoy somebody, His constant joking was beginning to annoy her.

words.general_translation_vi: Bị trái ý, khó chịu, bực mình
meanings: slightly angry.
examples: annoyed with somebody at/about something, He was beginning to get very annoyed with me about my carelessness.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm trái ý, làm khó chịu, làm bực mình
meanings: making somebody feel slightly angry.
examples: This interruption is very annoying.

words.general_translation_vi: Hàng năm, năm một, từng năm
meanings: happening or done once every year.
examples: an annual meeting/event/report/conference

meanings: one more; an extra thing or person.
examples: Would you like another drink?

meanings: something that you say, write or do to react to a question or situation.
examples: I rang the bell, but there was no answer.

words.general_translation_vi: Áy náy, lo âu, lo lắng, băn khoăn
meanings: feeling worried or nervous.
examples: The bus was late and Sue began to get anxious.

words.general_translation_vi: Một, một (người, vật) nào đó (trong câu hỏi)
meanings: used to emphasize an adjective or adverb in negative sentences or questions, meaning ‘at all’.
examples: He wasn't any good at French.

words.general_translation_vi: Một, một (người, vật) nào đó (trong câu hỏi)
meanings: often used at the end of negative sentences and at the end of questions, to mean ‘any longer’.
examples: She doesn't live here any more.

meanings: used instead of somebody in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
examples: Is there anybody who can help me?

meanings: used instead of someone in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.
examples: Is anyone there?

words.general_translation_vi: Vật gì, việc gì (trong câu phủ định và câu hỏi)
meanings: used instead of something in negative sentences and in questions; after if/whether; and after verbs such as prevent, ban, avoid, etc.
examples: Would you like anything else?

words.general_translation_vi: Thế nào cũng được, cách nào cũng được
meanings: used when adding something to support an idea or argument.
examples: It's too expensive and anyway the colour doesn't suit you.

words.general_translation_vi: Bất kỳ chỗ nào, bất cứ nơi đâu
meanings: used in negative sentences and in questions instead of somewhere.
examples: I can't see it anywhere.

words.general_translation_vi: Về một bên, qua một bên
meanings: separated by a distance, of space or time.
examples: The two houses stood 500 metres apart.

meanings: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building.
examples: an apartment building

meanings: to say that you are sorry for doing something wrong or causing a problem.
examples: Why should I apologize?

words.general_translation_vi: Rõ ràng, bày tỏ ra ngoài, thấy rõ ra ngoài
meanings: easy to see or understand.
examples: Their devotion was apparent.

meanings: according to what you have heard or read; according to the way something appears.
examples: Apparently they are getting divorced soon.

meanings: a deeply felt request for money, help or information that is needed immediately, especially one made by a charity or by the police.
examples: appeal for something, to launch a TV appeal for donations to the charity

words.general_translation_vi: Xuất hiện, hiện ra, ló ra
meanings: to start to be seen.
examples: Three days later a rash appeared.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự xuất hiện, sự hiện ra sự ló ra
meanings: the way that somebody/something looks on the outside; what somebody/something seems to be.
examples: the physical/outward/external appearance of something

words.general_translation_vi: Quả táo, quả táo tây. [từ thế kỷ IX]
meanings: a round fruit with shiny red or green skin that is fairly hard and white inside.
examples: Peel and core the apples.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự gắn vào, sự áp vào, sự ghép vào, sự đính vào, sự đắp vào, sự tra vào ((cũng) appliance)
meanings: a formal (often written) request for something, such as a job, permission to do something or a place at a college or university.
examples: a planning/patent/visa application

meanings: to make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a loan, permission for something, a place at a university, etc.
examples: You should apply in person/by letter.

words.general_translation_vi: Được bổ nhiệm, chức vụ được bổ nhiệm
meanings: a formal arrangement to meet or visit somebody at a particular time, especially for a reason connected with their work.
examples: I've got a dental appointment at 3 o'clock.

meanings: to recognize the good qualities of somebody/something.
examples: Over the years he came to appreciate the beauty and tranquillity of the river.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự đến gần, sự lại gần
meanings: a way of dealing with somebody/something; a way of doing or thinking about something such as a problem or a task.
examples: She took the wrong approach in her dealings with them.

meanings: suitable, acceptable or correct for the particular circumstances.
examples: an appropriate response/measure/method

words.general_translation_vi: Sự tán thành, sự đồng ý, sự chấp thuận
meanings: the feeling that somebody/something is good or acceptable; a positive opinion of somebody/something.
examples: She desperately wanted to win her father's approval.

words.general_translation_vi: Tán thành, đồng ý, bằng lòng, chấp thuận
meanings: to think that somebody/something is good, acceptable or suitable.
examples: I told my mother I wanted to leave school but she didn't approve.

meanings: used to show that something is almost, but not completely, accurate or correct.
examples: The journey took approximately seven hours.

meanings: the fourth month of the year, between March and May.
examples: in April, She was born in April.

meanings: a person whose job is designing buildings.
examples: The house was designed by architect Louis Kahn.

words.general_translation_vi: Thuật kiến trúc, khoa kiến trúc, khoa xây dựng
meanings: the art and study of designing buildings.
examples: to study architecture

meanings: part of a place, town, etc., or a region of a country or the world.
examples: to improve access to services in rural areas

meanings: to speak angrily to somebody because you disagree with them.
examples: My brothers are always arguing.

meanings: a conversation or discussion in which two or more people disagree, often angrily.
examples: to win/lose an argument

words.general_translation_vi: Xuất hiện, nảy sinh ra, xảy ra
meanings: to happen; to start to exist.
examples: An opportunity arose to work in the United States.

meanings: either of the two long parts that stick out from the top of the body and connect the shoulders to the hands.
examples: He escaped with only a broken arm.

meanings: involving the use of weapons.
examples: an armed robbery

meanings: a large organized group of soldiers who are trained to fight on land.
examples: The two opposing armies faced each other across the battlefield.

meanings: approximately.
examples: He arrived around five o'clock.

words.general_translation_vi: Sắp xếp, sắp đặt, sửa soạn
meanings: to plan or organize something in advance.
examples: arrange something, The party was arranged quickly.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự sắp xếp, sự sắp đặt, cái được sắp xếp, cái được sắp đặt
meanings: a plan or preparation that you make so that something can happen.
examples: Travel and accommodation arrangements have been finalized.

meanings: the act of arresting somebody.
examples: The police made several arrests.

meanings: an act of coming or being brought to a place.
examples: We apologize for the late arrival of the train.

meanings: to get to a place, especially at the end of a journey.
examples: I'll wait until they arrive.

meanings: the use of the imagination to express ideas or feelings, particularly in painting, drawing or sculpture.
examples: modern/contemporary art

meanings: a piece of writing about a particular subject in a newspaper or magazine, on a website, etc.
examples: to read/write/publish an article

meanings: made or produced to copy something natural; not real.
examples: an artificial limb/flower/sweetener/fertilizer

meanings: a person who creates works of art, especially paintings or drawings.
examples: an exhibition of work by contemporary British artists

meanings: connected with art or artists.
examples: the artistic works of the period

meanings: used when you are comparing two people or things, or two situations.
examples: You're as tall as your father.

meanings: feeling shame or feeling embarrassed about somebody/something or because of something you have done.
examples: ashamed of something, She was deeply ashamed of her behaviour at the party.

meanings: to say or write something in the form of a question, in order to get information.
examples: How old are you—if you don’t mind me/my asking?

meanings: sleeping.
examples: I waited until they were all fast asleep (= sleeping deeply).

meanings: a particular part or feature of a situation, an idea, a problem, etc.; a way in which it may be considered.
examples: aspect of something, The book aims to cover all aspects of city life.

words.general_translation_vi: Định giá (tài sản, hoa lợi... ) để đánh thuế
meanings: to make a judgement about the nature or quality of somebody/something.
examples: assess somebody/something, Accurately assessing environmental impacts is very complex.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự định giá (một vật) để đánh thuế
meanings: an opinion or a judgement about somebody/something that has been thought about very carefully.
examples: a detailed assessment of the risks involved

words.general_translation_vi: Sự giao việc, sự phân công
meanings: a task or piece of work that somebody is given to do, usually as part of their job or studies.
examples: Students are required to complete all homework assignments.

meanings: to help somebody to do something.
examples: Anyone willing to assist can contact this number.

words.general_translation_vi: Người giúp đỡ, người phụ tá
meanings: having a rank below that of a senior person and helping them in their work.
examples: the assistant manager/director/commissioner

words.general_translation_vi: Kết giao, kết hợp liên hợp
meanings: to make a connection between people or things in your mind.
examples: associate somebody/something with somebody/something, I always associate the smell of baking with my childhood.

meanings: if one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.
examples: associated with doing something, the risks associated with taking drugs

words.general_translation_vi: Sự kết hợp, sự liên hợp, sự liên kết
